results.detalle: Aggregated information on the total number of financial institutions authorized by the BCRA and currently active, meaning those whose authorization has not been revoked, in line with the information received in task 11 of the siscen system. the data corresponds to the balance at the close of operations on the last day of each month. in cases where up-to-date information is not available, the last known balance is repeated. for further details, it is recommended to consult the methodology document available on the BCRA website.
